passages.text: Our history club takes a small boat to an island in the lake. We follow the guide to an ancient stone wall above the shore. The stones are uneven, and a picture shows how the old building once looked. Instead of guessing every missing part, we mark the parts we can still see. Mia draws the doorway, while I compare its shape with the picture. On the boat home, we put our sketches beside the guide's notes. Our final page separates what we observed from what the picture suggests.

parallelText.en: Our history club takes a small boat to an island in the lake.
parallelText.zh: 历史社团乘小船到湖中一座岛上。

parallelText.en: We follow the guide to an ancient stone wall above the shore.
parallelText.zh: 我们跟随导游来到岸边高处一堵古老石墙前。

parallelText.en: The stones are uneven, and a picture shows how the old building once looked.
parallelText.zh: 石块不平整，一幅图片显示这座老建筑过去的模样。

parallelText.en: Instead of guessing every missing part, we mark the parts we can still see.
parallelText.zh: 我们不猜每处缺失部分，而是标出仍能看到的部分。

parallelText.en: Mia draws the doorway, while I compare its shape with the picture.
parallelText.zh: 米娅画门洞，我把它的形状与图片对照。

parallelText.en: On the boat home, we put our sketches beside the guide's notes.
parallelText.zh: 坐船回去时，我们把速写放在导游笔记旁。

parallelText.en: Our final page separates what we observed from what the picture suggests.
parallelText.zh: 最后的资料页把实际观察和图片所提示的内容分开记录。

passages.text: Our club builds a model lander to carry a paper flag onto a sand tray. We lower it from a chair instead of throwing it. On the first test, the flag falls out when the model touches the sand. Mia adds a paper holder, and we repeat the test in the same way. Now the flag stays inside until we open the model. The experience shows us why one change is easier to judge than many at once. We record both results before planning another test.

parallelText.en: Our club builds a model lander to carry a paper flag onto a sand tray.
parallelText.zh: 我们社团做了一个着陆器模型，把纸旗送到沙盘上。

parallelText.en: We lower it from a chair instead of throwing it.
parallelText.zh: 我们把它从椅子上放低，而不是抛出去。

parallelText.en: On the first test, the flag falls out when the model touches the sand.
parallelText.zh: 第一次测试时，模型一碰到沙，旗就掉了出来。

parallelText.en: Mia adds a paper holder, and we repeat the test in the same way.
parallelText.zh: 米娅加上一个纸制固定架，我们以相同方式再次测试。

parallelText.en: Now the flag stays inside until we open the model.
parallelText.zh: 这次旗一直留在里面，直到我们打开模型。

parallelText.en: The experience shows us why one change is easier to judge than many at once.
parallelText.zh: 这次经历让我们明白，一次只改一处，比同时改很多处更容易判断效果。

parallelText.en: We record both results before planning another test.
parallelText.zh: 计划下一次测试前，我们记录两次结果。
